current_evidence: The council's 'Planning Application Consultation' page (tameside.gov.uk/planning/consultation) links 'Validation Checklist July 2025' plus 13 per-application-type local list pages, and says the documents were 'approved on the 23 July 2025' and 'apply with immediate effect'. Grokbot's URL is an older undated page that holds only the Full-applications list.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link works but goes to the stand-alone 'Local List Full Applications' page, which is only one of Tameside's 13 per-application-type local lists. It does not link to the current hub page or to the guidance note approved in July 2025 (the 'Validation Checklist July 2025' PDF). The workbook should cite https://tameside.gov.uk/planning/consultation and the July 2025 checklist. WebFetch returned no machine-readable text for that PDF, so its contents could not be checked.
issues.evidence: tameside.gov.uk/planning/consultation: 'Validation Checklist July 2025'; 'approved on the 23 July 2025... apply with immediate effect'

issues.detail: The List date is null and the row is marked 'Undated'. The council's validation page states that the current requirements were approved on 23 July 2025.
issues.evidence: Planning Application Consultation page: 'approved on the 23 July 2025'

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 3 items from the Full-applications page. It missed all 27 items the page lists as 'may be required depending on the proposal': Biodiversity Survey and Report (with an ecology unit link if great crested newts are present), Air Quality assessment, Crime Impact Statement, Daylight/Sunlight assessment, Economic Statement, Environmental Impact Assessment / Environmental Statement, Flood Risk assessment, Foul sewage and utilities assessment, Heritage Statement, Land Contamination assessment, Lighting assessment, Noise Impact Assessment, Parking and servicing details, Photographs/Photomontages, Planning obligations/Unilateral Undertaking, Planning Statement, Refuse Disposal details, Retail Impact Assessment, Site Waste Management Plan, Statement of Community Involvement, Structural survey, Sustainability Statement, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Tree Survey and Ventilation/Extraction Statement.
issues.evidence: Local List Full Applications: items that 'may be required depending on the proposal' (Guidance Note)

issues.detail: Several mandatory local drawing requirements on the Full-applications list were also missed: a contextual drawing such as a street scene 'where appropriate'; unique drawing reference numbers and dimensions including to boundaries; existing and proposed vehicular and pedestrian access, visibility splays, gradients, parking and any right-of-way closure or diversion; trees and shrubs to be removed or retained, plus new planting; new boundary treatments; building materials and where they are used; and drawings showing how disabled people will be accommodated. The last of these appears only as stray text inside the DAS trigger.
issues.evidence: Local List Full Applications mandatory list; 'Your application will not be registered if the relevant information is missing'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but Tameside publishes a Householder local list. Its mandatory items include a Design and Access Statement where the property is a listed building or in a conservation area; land contamination measures such as gas protection membranes or garden cover systems; existing and proposed levels; access and parking; trees and landscaping; boundary treatments; materials; and refuse storage where appropriate. Items that may also be required are a daylight/sunlight assessment, ecological assessment, hard and soft landscaping details, Heritage Statement, parking and servicing details, and a planning statement.

Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent and Variation of condition s73 are all recorded as '(none)', but each has its own local list page on the council hub. The hub also has separate lists for Hedgerow, Prior Notification (Agricultural Building), Prior Notification (Demolition), Prior Notification (Agricultural Fish Tank) and Prior Notification (Agricultural Waste). Outline has two lists: 'all matters reserved' and 'some matters reserved'. Grokbot read only one page, so it did not see these.
issues.evidence: Hub links: 'Local List Outline Applications with all matters reserved', 'Local List Reserved Matters Applications', 'Local List Listed Building Applications', 'Local List Advertisement Consent Applications', 'Local List Application for removal or varying of a condition (S.73)'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', apparently because the text mentions change of use. The source is the Full-applications list: a DAS is required for full applications unless the proposal is a change of use with no external alterations. It is not a prior approval requirement. The trigger excerpt also runs on into the separate disabled-access drawing requirement.
issues.evidence: 'A Design and Access Statement must be submitted (unless the application is for a change of use with no external alterations)'

issues.detail: Site levels and refuse storage are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning'. The source page title names the application type ('Local List Full Applications'), so the placement is correct but the inference note is wrong. Refuse storage is required only 'where appropriate', and the trigger excerpt does keep that wording.
issues.evidence: Page title 'Local List Full Applications - Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council'

summary: Grokbot's URL works but holds only Tameside's Full-applications local list. The current requirements are the July 2025 Validation Checklist plus 13 per-application-type lists, approved 23 July 2025, so the date is also missing. Grokbot captured only 3 of about 35 items on that page, and it marks Householder and every other application type as having no local requirements even though each has its own published list.
